scope: Provided adapter source code only; no source browsing or execution by Gemini. Root verifies all numerical evidence with local Python and originals.
accepted_actions: Reject skip-extract if inputs/outputs are uncached or changed.
Retain explicit weekly period and prohibit annual comparison.
Include entity/scope/temporal/unit/aggregation dimensions in new series identifiers.
Reject decimal conversion unless exact Decimal(str(value)) equals the source decimal.
Only literal numeric zero can carry reported-zero interpretation.

not_adopted_or_bounded.claim: All monthly TPML cells may be annual cumulative flows
not_adopted_or_bounded.decision: No such cells in the complete selected original: current-month flows, current stock and prior-stock reference are explicitly distinguished; do not infer a cumulative type without source evidence.

not_adopted_or_bounded.claim: Require all sums to equal totals and only publish leaves
not_adopted_or_bounded.decision: Original totals/components retained; no general aggregation permission. Source internal differences or unknown units must not force correction or erase totals.

not_adopted_or_bounded.claim: Multi-year unknown period is contradictory / convert short years in adapter
not_adopted_or_bounded.decision: Unresolved-as-single-year denotes refusal to annualize, not a confirmed single year; original ROC-to-Gregorian conversion is verified in extraction, adapter must reject unconverted data.

not_adopted_or_bounded.claim: Expand shared cells for every geographic member
not_adopted_or_bounded.decision: Actual merged physical cell retained once with all shared scope metadata; expansion would duplicate a source quantity.
